title: Sirivantha
desc: Narayana Murthy wages a courageous battle to withstand all pressures and fight against corruption to retain the values he has cherished.

title: Kotee
desc: In the corrupt city of Janatha, Kotee, an honest man, defies the ruthless criminal Dinoo Savarkar in a bid to secure a better future for his sister. However, his defiance leads to overwhelming debts.

title: Nagadevathe
desc: Naganna, a worshipper of the snake goddess, vows celibacy in her honour, but is seduced by a dancer. When he dies from a snake bite, his brother starts to despise the deity.

title: Rakshasudu
desc: After getting appointed as an inspector, Arun undertakes a mission to track down a notorious serial killer who targets teen girls.

title: Mungaru Male 2
desc: Preetham, the son of Suryakanth, a millionaire, is driven by excitement and easily gets bored when it comes to relationships. He understands love after he meets Nandini.
